# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 7 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_007_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 7

**7:1** And when the child was two years old, Joachim said to Anna, "Let us bring her up to the temple of the Lord, that we may pay the vow we vowed, lest the Lord send upon us something untoward and our offering be unacceptable to him."

**7:2** And Anna said, "Let us wait until the third year, so that the child may not seek her father or mother." And Joachim said, "Let us wait."

**7:3** And when the child was three years old, Joachim said, "Let us call the undefiled daughters of the Hebrews, and let each one take a lamp, and let them be burning, that the child may not turn back and her heart be enticed away from the temple of the Lord."

**7:4** And they did so until they went up into the temple of the Lord. And the priest received her and kissed her and blessed her, saying, "The Lord God has magnified your name in all generations. In you the Lord shall reveal his redemption to the children of Israel in the last days."

**7:5** And he placed her on the third step of the altar, and the Lord God put grace upon her, and she danced with her feet and all the house of Israel loved her.
